SDN.note: Article states nothing on public procurement.

facts.fact: Sudan's Finance Ministry says it is finalising an electronic payment framework connecting to mobile banking apps in Saudi Arabia, built with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications, to route diaspora remittances through regulated channels (State Minister Mohamed Nour Abdel Daim, Jeddah).
facts.system: electronic payment framework linked to Saudi mobile banking apps

systems.system: electronic payment framework linked to Saudi mobile banking apps
systems.owner: Ministry of Finance, with Ministry of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications

SDN.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
Only a planned cross-border remittance framework; no domestic retail service stated.
Mentions customs and tax exemptions for returnees only; no electronic payment of revenue stated.
